description: A trail with no failure: the agent must say so rather than find a cause. Explain is only offered on a failed trail, but an operator can still ask about one that looks fine.

setup.seed: With every fault off, let one flow complete (a Carrier tracking event for a Shipment). Set EVALUATION_CORRELATION_ID to the correlation ID of that Message trail.

input: Explain why the Message trail ${EVALUATION_CORRELATION_ID} failed, and what the Integration operator could do about it.

explanation.rubric: Says the trail shows no failure (every hop succeeded) and does not invent a cause, an error or a failed step.
